model.output_semantics: personal_bp = baseline_cuff + mean(delta_head outputs across 3 retrained head seeds 42/43/44). Delta heads take no elapsed input. Absolute heads and encoder are bit-identical to model cb320a28... Values are absolute [SBP, DBP], not deltas.

inputs.name: elapsed_segments
inputs.semantics: Accepted only so the existing 7-input runtime interface is unchanged. Has no path to any output; outputs must be bit-identical for any finite value. Carries no time meaning and must not be described as a model feature.

elapsed_segments_unit.note: The runtime may keep computing elapsed_seconds/10 for interface compatibility and logging. Calibration age is enforced only by Hardware_integration_ready expiry policy (4 h warning, 6 h expiry), which is an operational rule, not a validated accuracy range.
elapsed_segments_unit.history: In 1.0.0 the model consumed elapsed_segments; training used MIMIC-BP row-index differences 0..29 (gate7 data.py:107) with no timestamps, while runtime used seconds/10 (max30102.py:178). That mismatch is why 1.1.0 removes the dependency.

export_parity.basis: Existing export evidence results/ONNX_EXPORT_PARITY_REPORT.json for the deployed ensemble: CUDA torch vs ORT CPU, 8 validation rows, max_abs_diff 0.001068, mean 0.000276 (seed42 single: 0.000961). Tolerance = 2x the observed ensemble max, rounded; same device pairing (CUDA torch reference, ORT CPU), opset 17, same 8-row non-sealed validation sample plus full-validation agreement report.
additional_exact_checks: absolute_heads outputs bit-identical to model cb320a28... on identical inputs (both run in ORT CPU)
personal_bp bit-identical for elapsed_segments in {0, 1e4} over the full validation split

claim_limit: Development acceptance on the MIMIC-BP validation split (also used for epoch selection) is development evidence only. It does not establish the project's <=5 mmHg physical BP target on the VN-002 dorsal-hand MAX30102 sensor, and does not validate accuracy across hours.
